description: Returns a company's income statement, balance sheet and cash flow statement as filed with the SEC in XBRL: the last 12 calendar quarters or the last 6 fiscal years, 30+ lines, with the filing behind each period. Use it when the user asks for a company's revenue, earnings, balance sheet or cash flow over several periods. Lines computed from filed lines say how (`computed`); a null is a line the company did not file for that period: report it as unknown. Cash outflows (capex, buybacks, dividends paid) are negative. A foreign private issuer files once a year (20-F): its statements are fiscal years whatever the basis asked — unless it files its quarterly statements as Form 6-K (ASML, Nebius, STMicro and others): those quarters are included, each with its 6-K and `audited: false`. Amounts are in the filing currency. For a foreign issuer that publishes its quarters only in releases filed as Form 6-K (TSMC), `releases` adds its monthly revenue, quarterly results and guidance — unaudited, and kept apart from the statements. `revenueBy` breaks revenue down by segment, geography and product as the company's own tables present it (only tables whose lines add up to the total filed), and `customerConcentration` lists the customers it discloses with their share of revenue, labels as filed ("Customer A": a customer the company does not name). statement=breakdowns returns only those two. `guidance` is what the company's latest earnings release says it expects (revenue, gross margin, eps, each with its basis and period), `actualVsGuidance` what it then filed against its own guidance, `nextEarnings` the estimated date of its next results; statement=outlook returns only those.

basis.description: quarterly (default: last 12 calendar quarters) or annual (last 6 fiscal years).

statement.description: income, balance, cashflow, breakdowns (revenue by segment, geography and product, and customer concentration), outlook (the company's guidance, actuals against it, next earnings date) or all (default all).

symbol.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. NVDA, AMD, ASML, 'nvidia', 'taiwan semiconductor'. Case-insensitive.

name: get_financials
title: Financial statements as filed
